title: Whitney graphic identity manual
slide_intent: Expose the construction idea at the point of handoff so another designer can understand the system before using its templates.
strategic_value: The cover’s division instruction can make Whitney’s flexible mark legible as a repeatable procedure.
demonstration: An angled white manual pairs a large uppercase instruction with a faint four-part rectangle.
practical_value: Use a manual cover to connect an identity’s defining operation to the guidance it contains; do not mistake this cover photograph for the complete manual.

content_islands.name: Instruction
content_islands.spec: Set the oversized uppercase division instruction on the upper cover.

content_islands.name: Construction field
content_islands.spec: Place four adjacent equal spaces beneath the words, retaining the photographed book edges.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent essay describes the identity as a system represented by a line drawing and introduces a five-step construction procedure.
reference_purposes.Expression: The photographed cover uses tightly stacked black uppercase text and a restrained line diagram.
